title: A Closed-Form Soft Spectral Partition for Adaptive Mode Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2611.29452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Density-based Adaptive Mode Decomposition (DAMD) shows that the Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) objective, restricted to hard binary partitions, is equivalent to weighted K-means clustering, enabling automatic mode detection. The equivalence concerns detection only; extraction with hard Voronoi masks introduces boundary artefacts. This paper develops a soft extraction theory independent of the detector. First, the hard-partition equivalence is shown to be an algebraic identity that holds if and only if the weights are binary; hard and soft extraction are optima of two different functionals (linear K-means and regularised quadratic VMD) over the same simplex. Second, the regularised soft VMD problem is proved to have a closed-form global optimum, unique on the support of the spectrum: the Lorentzian-weighted partition $s_k^*(\omega)\propto[1+2\alpha(\omega-\omega_k)^2]^{-1}$. translated_title: 面向自适应模态分解的闭式软谱划分
translated_abstract: 基于密度的自适应模态分解（DAMD）表明，当变分模态分解（VMD）的目标函数被限制在硬二值划分上时，它等价于加权K均值聚类，从而能够实现自动模态检测。然而这种等价性仅适用于检测环节；使用硬Voronoi掩码进行模态提取会引入边界伪影。本文独立于检测器发展了一套软提取理论。首先，硬划分等价性被证明是一个代数恒等式，当且仅当权重为二值时成立；硬提取与软提取分别是同一单纯形上两个不同泛函（线性K均值与正则化二次VMD）的最优解。其次，本文证明了正则化软VMD问题存在闭式全局最优解，且在谱支撑集上唯一，即洛伦兹加权的谱划分 $s_k^*(\omega)\propto[1+2\alpha(\omega-\omega_k)^2]^{-1}$。VMD ADMM模态更新的每个不动点都具有……
tldr: 本文证明了正则化软VMD问题存在唯一且闭式表示的全局最优解——洛伦兹加权谱划分，从而为自适应模态分解建立了一套独立于检测器的软提取理论，克服了硬划分提取带来的边界伪影问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the regularised soft VMD problem admits a unique closed-form global optimum—the Lorentzian-weighted spectral partition—establishing a detector-independent soft extraction theory for adaptive mode decomposition that eliminates boundary artefacts of hard partitions.
